title: TH17 cells contribute to uveitis and scleritis and are inhibited by IL-27/STAT1 in the retina. \(2) Expression of IL-17 in mouse PBMC, lymph node and retina
protocol: Into a 50 ml polypropylene tube, add 0.5 ml of bovine IRBP protein (6 mg/ml) and 6 mg of lyophilized human IRBP peptide (1-20).
Bring the mixture to a final volume of 2 ml.
Add an equal volume or 2 ml of Complete Freund adjuvant (CFA) containing Mycobacterium tuberculosis strain H37Ra (2.5 mg/ml), mix and chill on ice for 10 min.
Sonicate at high speed on ice for 20 seconds followed by 30 seconds intervals.
Repeat sonication 4-5 times until the mixture appears as a thick white cream.
Centrifuge the emulsion at 1200 RPM for 1 min.
Prepare CFA emulsion without IRBP to serve as control.
Transfer the antigen/CFA emulsion into 1 ml syringes with 19 gauge blunt-ended needles.
Prepare PTX solution at a concentration of 2 ug/ml.
Prepare sufficient PTX solution for each mouse (100 μl/mouse).
Prepare sufficient CFA/Antigen emulsions for each mouse (200 μl/mouse).
Expel any air bubbles in the syringe containing PTX or emulsion before injection.
Inject each mouse with 100 μl of PTX solution intraperitoneally.
Inject emulsion subcutaneously into the base of the tail (100 μl) and each thigh (50 μl).
Sacrifice immunized mice at post-immunization days -7, -14, -21, and -28.
Restrain mice for examination by intraperitoneal injection of a mixture of Ketamine and xylazine at 30 mg/kg and 9 mg/kg, respectively.
After 5-10 minutes, dilate pupils with one drop of Mydriacyl (1%) to each eye.
Gently press the cover glass on the cornea for fundoscopy.
Adjust head position to focus the retina in the fundoscope for examination.
Incubate enucleated eyes overnight in 10% buffered formaldehyde.
Embed eyes and cut 5 μm paraffin sections in an anterior/posterior orientation.
Stain sections with hematoxylin & eosin (H&E).
Dilute IL-17 or IgD2a isotype control antibodies in PBS.
Inject 500 μl IL-17 antibody (350 μg) intraperitoneally into treatment group (4 mice) 1 day before immunization with IRBP/CFA emulsion (day -1).
Inject 500 μl IgD2a isotype control antibody (350 μg) intraperitoneally into control group (4 mice) 1 day before immunization with IRBP/CFA emulsion (day -1).
Repeat Ab injection every other day until day 17 post-immunization.
Perform fundoscopic examinations at post-immunization days 12, 14 and 16.
Sacrifice mice at post-immunization day-19 and perform histology.
Immunise mice (8) with CFA or IRBP/CFA emulsion.
Monitor EAU progression by fundoscopy and histology.
Sacrifice mice at post-immunization days, 0, 7, 14, 21 and 28.
Section one eye for histology and stain with H&E.
Isolate RNA and protein extracts from retina, PBMC or lymph nodes.
Analyze IL-27 protein expression by Western blotting.
Analyze IL27 and Ebi3 expression by RT-PCR and qPCR.
